description: Header file defining the CommonEncryptionData class for handling media encryption data, including parsing PSSH boxes, XML, and JSON init data, and managing key IDs and system types.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData
classes.description: Handles parsing and management of media encryption data, including key IDs and system types.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData::KeyId
classes.description: Represents a key identifier with associated system type, extending OCDM::KeyId.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData(const uint8_t data[], const uint16_t length)
methods.description: Constructor that parses encryption data from a byte array.

methods.name: Status(const KeyId& key)
methods.description: Returns the key status for a specific key ID.

methods.name: Keys()
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the key IDs.

methods.name: HasKeyId(const OCDM::KeyId& keyId)
methods.description: Checks if a key ID is present.

methods.name: AddKeyId(const KeyId& key)
methods.description: Adds a new key ID or updates an existing one.

methods.name: UpdateKeyStatus(::OCDM::ISession::KeyStatus status, const KeyId& key)
methods.description: Updates the status of a key ID.

methods.name: IsSupported(const CommonEncryptionData& keys)
methods.description: Checks if the current keys support another set of keys.

methods.name: IsEmpty()
methods.description: Checks if there are no key IDs.

methods.name: Base64(const uint8_t value[], const uint8_t sourceLength, uint8_t object[], const uint8_t length)
Parse(const uint8_t data[], const uint16_t length)
methods.description: Parses encryption data from a byte array.

methods.name: ParsePSSHBox(const uint8_t data[], const uint16_t length)
methods.description: Parses a PSSH box to extract key information.

methods.name: FindInXML(const uint8_t data[], const uint16_t length, const char key[], const uint8_t keyLength)
methods.description: Finds a string in XML data.

methods.name: ParseXMLBox(const uint8_t data[], const uint16_t length)
methods.description: Parses XML data for key IDs.

methods.name: ParseJSONInitData(const char data[], uint16_t length)
methods.description: Parses JSON initialization data for key IDs.
